requirements.description: Inspection distinguishes current linux-yocto 6.6, inactive 6.1 append, fragment, meta-local dummy config, and dirty runqemu
Pre-fix show-appends and virtual/kernel metadata prove the fragment is inactive
Post-fix show-appends, SRC_URI, and config audit prove the fragment is consumed
A detached ordinary virtual/kernel build succeeds with kernel artifact/signature evidence
The matching validation image succeeds with kernel, rootfs, and qemuboot artifacts
Guest /proc/config.gz contains CONFIG_IKCONFIG=y and CONFIG_IKCONFIG_PROC=y with exit 0
Guest has no kernel panic; CONFIG_DUMMY=m, meta-local, Poky, and runqemu remain protected
